moa: Anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) tyrosine kinase inhibitor

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 205755 ACCELERATED APPROVAL ... for Zykadia (ceritinib) capsules, 150 mg

series_start_reason: First Novartis interim report that prints a Zykadia sales row is the Q2 2014 report (7, with the prior-year column 0); the Q1 2014 report prints no Zykadia row (FDA approval was April 2014, per the Q2 2014 report text).
series_end_reason: From the Q1 2017 interim report (0001370368-17-000038, a170425-99_2.htm) Novartis no longer prints a Zykadia net sales row: the Oncology product table lists Tasigna, Tafinlar + Mekinist, Votrient, Promacta/Revolade, Jakavi and 'Other 223 | 251', and Zykadia appears only in pipeline/approval tables. The Q4 2016 report (0001370368-17-000004) is the last with a Zykadia row (Q4 2016 22; FY 2016 91).
notes: Novartis group net sales of Zykadia as a single row of the product net sales table; no regional split is printed on that table, and the table is the group's third-party net sales. Four-quarter checks against the Q4 reports' own FY columns: 2014 Q2+Q3+Q4 = 7+12+12 = 31 (FY 2014 31; Q1 2014 not printed); 2015 = 16+18+21+24 = 79 (FY 79); 2016 = 24+24+21+22 = 91 (FY 91). The FY2017 20-F was searched for a Zykadia sales figure and prints none (no annual series extension). Cross-check: every quarter's own figure equals the next year's prior-year column (e.g. Q2 2015 report prior-year column 7, Q3 2015 12, Q4 2015 12, Q1 2016 16, Q2 2016 18, Q3 2016 21, Q4 2016 24).
search_log: Listed Novartis (CIK 1114448) 6-K and 6-K/A filings from 2012-06 on via data.sec.gov submissions (current and older pages, 287 filings, no form filter beyond the 6-K family); fetched index.json for each and downloaded the EX-99.2 interim financial report (nvs-*-99_2.htm or a*-99_2.htm) of every quarter 2012Q2 through 2026Q2 (58 htm documents).

Extracted every table row whose first cell equals the brand by script (BeautifulSoup) and read the header above it; Zykadia has a numeric row from the Q2 2014 report through the Q4 2016 report and none after.
Searched all 2017-2026 reports for the word Zykadia: it appears only in pipeline and regulatory tables (Q1 and Q2 2017 reports).

Searched Novartis 20-F annual reports FY2014-FY2017 (0001047469-15-000433, -16-009872, -17-000338, -18-000380) for a Zykadia sales figure: FY2014 31, FY2015 79 (consistent with the quarters); no FY2017 figure printed.
Bigdata.com used to locate the filings; all cited URLs are the sec.gov Archives originals.
